title: Amul catalog failure rate is high

model.expr: (100 * sum by (project, environment, service) (increase(amul_stock_checker_catalog_requests_total{project="amul-stock-checker", environment="production", service="api", status="error"}[15m])) / clamp_min(sum by (project, environment, service) (increase(amul_stock_checker_catalog_requests_total{project="amul-stock-checker", environment="production", service="api"}[15m])), 1)) and on (project, environment, service) (sum by (project, environment, service) (increase(amul_stock_checker_catalog_requests_total{project="amul-stock-checker", environment="production", service="api"}[15m])) >= 20)

annotations.summary: Amul catalog failure rate is high
annotations.description: The Amul catalog request failure rate was {{ $values.A.Value }} percent over fifteen minutes, across at least 20 attempts, and stayed above 20 percent for five minutes.
